step1.title: Breaking Down the Web /w Dan Jutan
step1.description:
Dan Jutan, Solid Core Team member in charge of Documentation, joins me tonight to help give context for a lot of the topics we cover on stream. We are going back to the fundamentals of Web architecture and performance answering any questions along the way. Expect lots of drawing.

[0:00] Introduction
[3:50] This Week in JavaScript
[1:11:17] Sketching the Page Load
[1:28:39] Looking at Timelines
[1:36:55] SSR vs CSR Timeline
[1:47:24] Comparing Rendering
[2:16:52] Comparing Routing
[2:52:16] Outro
